name: PoE1 Path of Building (Beta)
description: Plan Path of Exile builds, edit skills and equipment, and compare trade upgrades using a pinned Path of Building Community beta engine. Full-access add-on.
setupRequirements: Trade features require signing in to the official Path of Exile trade website. Build planning works without signing in.

name: PoE2 Path of Building (Beta)
description: Plan Path of Exile 2 builds, manage loadouts and skill groups, and rank trade upgrades using a pinned Path of Building Community beta engine. Full-access add-on.
setupRequirements: Trade features require signing in to the official Path of Exile trade website. Build planning works without signing in.

name: MapGenie
description: Explore interactive game maps, find collectibles and track your progress.
setupRequirements: A MapGenie account is needed to save map progress; some website features require a paid plan.

name: Twitch
description: Watch Twitch streams with controller navigation and pinnable webapp windows.
setupRequirements: A Twitch account is needed for chat and account features. Twitch controls stream access and subscription requirements.

name: Discord
description: Use Discord's web app with controller input and pinnable pop-outs.
setupRequirements: Sign in with your Discord account in the widget's website view.

name: Game Help
description: Ask for game hints with screenshots and clips.
setupRequirements: Requires your own Gemini API key. Google's API quotas and any usage charges apply.

name: Display Profiles
description: Save and restore monitor layouts, resolutions and refresh rates. Display changes use a timed confirmation with automatic rollback.

name: Playnite Library
description: Browse and launch your Playnite games.
setupRequirements: Requires Playnite running with the separate Playnite Bridge extension installed.
Enter the API token from Playnite Bridge settings when connecting the widget.

name: Spotify
description: Browse your Spotify library and control playback with your controller.
setupRequirements: Requires a Spotify account and your own Spotify developer app Client ID.
Register http://127.0.0.1:43827/callback/ as the app's redirect URI. Spotify developer-mode access restrictions apply.
Spotify Premium is required for playback controls and listening through WidgetRail.

name: YouTube Video
description: Search and watch YouTube with a pinnable player.
setupRequirements: Search requires your own Google API key with YouTube Data API v3 enabled. Opening a video link does not require a search key.

name: YouTube Music
description: Browse music and keep playback controls pinned while playing.
setupRequirements: A Google account is needed for your personal library. Sign-in opens Chrome, or Edge as a fallback.
Public search and supported playback can work without signing in. No developer app, Python installation or YTMDesktop is required.

name: Audio Mixer
description: Adjust application volume, switch audio devices and control microphone levels without leaving your game.

name: Capture Library
description: Browse your screenshots and recordings, preview captures and manage saved files.

name: Performance Monitor
description: Check system and process performance and pin live statistics while playing.

name: Media Controls
description: Control playback in apps that expose Windows media sessions.
setupRequirements: Playback controls depend on the active media app supporting Windows media controls.

name: Games & Apps
description: Find, pin and launch your installed games and applications.

name: Task Switcher
description: Switch between open windows and close or restart applications with your controller.

name: Network Controls
description: Manage Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and connected devices through Windows.
setupRequirements: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth controls require compatible hardware and drivers. Some Windows-managed changes may require keyboard or mouse interaction.

name: Power
description: Lock, sleep, restart or shut down your PC from the overlay.

name: Recent Apps
description: Reopen recently used applications from a compact list.

name: Browser
description: Open websites in a controller-friendly browser and keep pages pinned while playing.
setupRequirements: Websites may require their own accounts or subscriptions.
